# Cody Anthony — Documentation Strategist

> Portfolio of Cody Anthony, a documentation strategist specializing in content systems for complex software products: information architecture, docs-as-code, editorial standards, and AI-assisted documentation workflows with human-in-the-loop validation. Eight years of shipped work across AWS (Amazon EVS launch documentation, the ROSA documentation practice, the DocBook XML→AsciiDoc modernization program) and Cloudflare (the solution-guide content type and its agentic authoring pipeline).

Every case-study and blog link below points to a plain-Markdown rendition generated from the authored source. For the rendered HTML page, replace the trailing `.md` with a trailing slash. Every case study describes shipped production work; several link to public, verifiable artifacts (AWS documentation, Cloudflare docs pull requests).

## Case studies — documentation strategy & systems

- [Solution Guide Content Type & Authoring System](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/cloudflare/solution-guide-system.md): A new cross-product content type at Cloudflare — content model, information architecture, and the agentic authoring pipeline built to scale it.
- [AI-Assisted Content Gap Analysis](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/cloudflare/ai-content-gap-analysis.md): Mining developer feedback across public and internal channels to quantify documentation gaps and ground the solution-guide content type in real evidence.
- [AsciiDoc Modernization Program](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/systems-strategy/adoc-modernization.md): Migrating AWS service docs from XML to AsciiDoc, unblocking contributors and AI workflows. From ROSA to EKS, SAP on AWS, and high-compliance regions.
- [Documentation Prioritization Framework](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/systems-strategy/rosa-doc-prioritization.md): A tiered, RICE-aligned prioritization framework and quarterly review that helped ROSA documentation and its partners align on what to document first.
- [ROSA Jobs-to-be-Done Content Redesign](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/systems-strategy/rosa-jtbd-redesign.md): Restructuring ROSA docs around customer workflows — merged duplicate pages, consolidated policy docs, and retitled pages to match customer goals.

## Case studies — technical documentation & reference

- [EVS CreateEnvironment API Reference](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/api-documentation/evs-createenvironment.md): Parameter constraints, validation rules, and error responses, each example verified against the live API.
- [Amazon EVS CloudFormation Reference](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/api-documentation/evs-cloudformation.md): Resource and property docs for environment-creation parameters, written for template authors.
- [Amazon EVS Getting Started Guide](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/architecture-guides/evs-getting-started.md): Owned end-to-end across three launches. Written for on-prem VMware administrators new to AWS networking.
- [EVS HCX Migration & Connectivity](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/architecture-guides/evs-hcx-migration.md): Private and public connectivity paths, covering VPC, IPAM, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and Elastic IPs.
- [ROSA with HCP Getting Started Guide](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/architecture-guides/rosa-getting-started.md): Terraform and CLI-based workflow for provisioning ROSA clusters.
- [Cloudflare Cross-Product Solution Guides](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/cloudflare/solution-guides.md): Cookbook-style workflows across multiple products, authored docs-as-code and completable on Free plans.

## Case studies — product content design

- [Design Influence & Upstream Collaboration](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/console-ux/console-api-design.md): Embedding with product and engineering during design, shaping console UX and API decisions before documentation plans get written.
- [EVS API Exception UX](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/console-ux/evs-api-exception-ux.md): Aligning a public API's exceptions with real product behavior and AWS API standards — standards-aligned errors with clear deprecation guidance over removing API surface.
- [EVS Day 1 Deployment Experience](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/console-ux/evs-day1-deployment.md): Console microcopy, 28 help panels, and deployment documentation designed as a unified Day 1 experience, shipped with general availability.
- [HCX API Design Collaboration](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/console-ux/evs-hcx-api-design.md): Participating in EVS HCX API design reviews as the docs lead, surfacing maintainability concerns and aligning the API with AWS-wide standards.
- [EVS VLAN Subnet Naming](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/console-ux/evs-vlan-naming.md): Naming a new EVS networking resource so it serves both VMware and AWS audiences, carried consistently across every EVS surface.
- [Cross-Service Service Quotas Integration Strategy](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/console-ux/cross-service-service-quotas.md): How operational patterns from prior AWS launches shaped the Service Quotas design for Amazon EVS.
- [ROSA with Hosted Control Planes Launch](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/console-ux/rosa-hcp-console-integration.md): Console UX and documentation for the ROSA HCP launch, standardizing terminology across AWS and Red Hat.
- [ROSA Day 1 Experience](https://codyanthony.dev/case-studies/console-ux/rosa-prerequisites-automation.md): Console automation for ROSA prerequisite validation, paired with AWS-native getting started documentation.

## Blog
